subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a refreshed iOS Control tab card layout with prominent Chat/Talk entry points after this branch is rebased and visually proven against current main?
rationale: The change would alter the default iOS Control experience for all users and overlaps newer merged native iOS visual work, so automation cannot choose the product direction from code correctness alone.

options.title: Require refreshed proof first
options.body: Keep this PR open until the contributor rebases, fixes the scoped typography issue, and attaches matched before/after screenshots so maintainers can judge the design.

options.title: Sponsor the card layout
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly adopt the direction and ask for a main-based implementation that preserves current navigation and routing.

options.title: Reject or narrow the redesign
options.body: A maintainer can close or narrow the linked feature direction if the current native List-based Control hub is the desired design.

recommendation.title: Require refreshed proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until the contributor rebases, fixes the scoped typography issue, and attaches matched before/after screenshots so maintainers can judge the design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on this PR, authored overlapping visual hierarchy work, and already requested the exact proof needed before a design decision.
